highlights: **Connections:** Large server configurations on slow links no longer trigger reconnect loops. T3 Connect restarts dropped tunnel clients, and threads can keep syncing after a stream failure.

**Conversations:** Stopping a run no longer collapses its visible history to one row. Older pending questions remain answerable, deleted forks disappear from Lineage, and interrupted wakeups preserve sibling work.
**Agents:** Claude tool calls can render MCP Apps. Agents can request secrets through the dedicated secret-request flow instead of asking you to paste them into chat.
**Mobile:** Keyboard and autocorrect handling is more consistent. Android wide-image pinch gestures work across the viewer, while iOS image previews and thread menus are easier to use.
**Claude and limits:** Mobile can configure another Claude account and compact stale Claude threads before sending. Sharing-limit notices expose existing recovery options more consistently.

**Projects:** An optional ghq-style clone layout organizes new clones under host/owner/repository folders. Pull-request description preferences save correctly, and Changes totals name their comparison base.
**Sidebar:** Project filter rows stay aligned on hover. Working threads keep their Working-section placement during disconnects; our project-folder Working and snooze controls remain available.
